verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official CLI that lets developers deploy from the terminal, which covers the deploy half of the story. Nothing shows a single command that both scaffolds a new project and deploys it. The one-command claim in docs-19 is about installing the CLI and configuring agent support, and the one-click starters in docs-17 are not described as CLI features. missing for 10: documented single-command scaffold-plus-deploy, CLI project creation/scaffolding from templates, hands-on corroboration of the CLI workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.
